button.note: R stays a Track 1 button; the game folds it to R+A+Z; no combined action exists

mode.tap: button on tick 1 only, none on ticks 2..tau

contract.per_tick_word: stick on every tick; button per mode; exactly one Track 1 action per consumed tick

termination.boundary_ticks: i >= 2 (a change on tick 1 is the option's own intended effect)
termination.boundary_source: raw native reply: table-v2 class of fighter_status_id, ground_air_state, air_velocity_y (> 0 then <= 0 while airborne), entity hitlag_tics (> 0 then 0), targets_remaining (decreased); none across a non-live reply
termination.rollout_boundary: training only: the environment's rollout tick quota is used up

contract.no_hidden_input: ending an option submits nothing; the next decision's first tick follows immediately
contract.duration_one: d = 1 emits exactly the Track 1 word of (stick, button) in both modes
contract.replay_truth: the per-tick canonical native words recorded below this layer (M4 actions.jsonl)
contract.reward: the undiscounted sum of the per-tick rewards; the learner discounts per tick
